answer: Make new identities pay in time, not just tokens: each account's grading weight grows only after it survives several epochs of peer review, and every grade it signs with its quill is later scored against the consensus. A sybil farm must keep hundreds of accounts writing distinct work (no recycled sonnet templates) and voting accurately for weeks; one rising tide of correlated scores from linked accounts triggers slashing of their staked, time-locked balance.
